enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn head to left. Turn head to right. Pull blanket up to chin. Move left arm under pillow. Move right arm under pillow. Turn body to left side. Bend knees. Turn body to right side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Splash water on face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Reply to message. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk to office building. Open door. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Write notes. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Walk to meeting room. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Type report. Print document. Pick up printout. Review document. File document.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Throw away trash. Walk outside. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open program files. Review documents. Edit document. Save file. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Write email. Send email. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Update database. Print agenda. Pick up printout. Distribute agenda. Talk to supervisor. Return to desk. Organize files.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk home.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out pan from cupboard. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables and meat to pan. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Take out drink from refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open browser. Check social media. Write email. Pay bills online. Browse internet. Watch video. Close browser. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Put down book. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select song. Play music. Put down phone. Listen to music. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Put down book.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Pull blanket up to chin.
